Description of the accident (claimant's words)
I was merging from the middle lane onto the freeway in League City, Texas, when I checked my mirror and moved
over to make the lane change. A vehicle in the adjacent lane came up alongside me and clipped the rear quarter
panel of my car, pushing me toward the shoulder before I could steer back. I pulled onto the shoulder right away and
stayed in my vehicle until the other driver and I had exchanged our information. I have been the named driver on this
policy for several years and I am the person who was behind the wheel at the time. Since the collision I have had
stiffness and pain in my neck and lower back, and my doctor has diagnosed both as muscle strain. I have described
the event the same way every time I have spoken about it, to the adjuster, to the officer on scene, and to my
physician, and I am glad to provide any further detail that would help process this claim.
